title: Imify
subtitle: The Powerful Image Toolkit
aboutText1: Imify was born out of a simple need: Privacy-First image processing. Unlike online converters that upload your data to remote servers, Imify handles every single byte locally right in your browser memory.
aboutText2: Built for developers, designers, and privacy enthusiasts who need quick, reliable, and secure image formatting without compromise.

pwaDialog.title: Install Imify as App
pwaDialog.desc: Imify can be installed directly as a Progressive Web App (PWA) on your device.
pwaDialog.benefit1: Runs 100% offline without requiring internet access
pwaDialog.benefit2: Quick launch from your home screen or taskbar
pwaDialog.benefit3: Standalone desktop window experience with no browser address bar clutter
pwaDialog.alreadyInstalled: PWA app is already installed or device does not support installation.
